title: Stock: new tires, oil and batteries
neverUpdated: Numbers have not been updated on this device yet — press “Refresh numbers”
pendingExplain: Fittings and oil changes recorded on this device and not sent yet are already subtracted from these numbers.
pendingExplainSome: Some work recorded on this device has not been sent yet — it is already subtracted from these numbers.
refreshOffline: No connection — these are the last numbers saved on this device.
empty: No stock recorded. If a shipment arrived, ask the person in charge of stock to record it.
emptyCanReceive: No stock recorded. If a shipment arrived, press “Receive stock” and record it.
noTires: No new tires recorded in stock
tiresBreakdown: Recorded count {{counted}} — {{pending}} of them fitted and not sent yet
oilBreakdown: Recorded amount {{counted}} — {{pending}} of it used and not sent yet

level.negativeTires: Below zero: more tires were fitted than recorded — check the stock count
level.negativeOil: Below zero: more oil was used than recorded — check the stock count
level.negativeBatteries: Below zero: more batteries were fitted than recorded — check the count

receive.notAllowed: Only the person in charge of stock and management can receive stock (record a new shipment). If a shipment arrived, tell them to record it.
receive.title: Receive stock
receive.subtitle: Record the shipment that arrived: new tires, oil or batteries. A connection is required.
receive.needsOnline: No connection right now — a receipt can only be recorded when the connection is back.
receive.notePlaceholder: For example: invoice number or supplier name
receive.reviewLead: This will be added to stock:
receive.noUndo: Check the quantity carefully: a receipt cannot be taken back from here once recorded.
receive.retrySafe: Press “Retry” — it will not be counted twice.

err.qty: Type how many: a number from 1 to {{max}}
err.liters: Type the amount in liters: more than zero, up to {{max}}
err.tooLong: The name is too long — {{max}} characters at most

count.title: Stock count
count.subtitle: Count what is actually there and type the number — the recorded figure will be corrected to it. A connection is required.
count.unsentNotIncluded: Some work recorded on this device has not been sent yet ({{n}}). It is not included in this recorded figure, and will be subtracted from it once sent.
count.notReceiving: A count is only for fixing a difference between the recorded figure and what is there. If a new shipment arrived, do not record it here — use “Receive stock”.
count.needsOnline: No connection right now — a count can only be recorded when the connection is back.
count.askTires: How many tires are actually there?
count.askOil: How many liters are actually there?
count.zeroHint: If there is none at all, type zero.
count.notePlaceholder: For example: the reason for the difference, or who counted
count.same: Same as the recorded figure — nothing will change.
count.willRemove: {{n}} will be taken off the recorded figure
count.willAdd: {{n}} will be added to the recorded figure
count.fixLater: If the number turns out wrong after recording, do another count with the right number.
count.retrySafe: Press “Retry” — it will not be counted twice.
count.doneSame: The figure is unchanged — nothing was changed

err.tires: Type how many: zero or a whole number up to {{max}}
err.oil: Type the amount in liters: zero or a number up to {{max}}
err.batteries: Enter the count: zero or a whole number up to {{max}}

count.askBatteries: How many new batteries are actually there?

noBatteries: No new batteries recorded in stock
noBatteriesCanReceive: No new batteries recorded in stock. If a shipment arrived, press "Receive stock" and record it.
batteriesBreakdown: Recorded {{counted}} — {{pending}} of them fitted and not sent yet
